name: VRAM Monitor
description:
Shows GPU video memory (VRAM) usage in the top bar.

* Used, free and total VRAM, GTT usage
* Per-process VRAM and GTT usage, sorted by VRAM (processes of the current user)
* Configurable label format, alert threshold, refresh interval and GPU

Currently supports AMD GPUs (amdgpu driver). Data is read from sysfs and /proc, no external tool is used.
